import networkx as nx
from qiskit import QuantumCircuit
from qiskit.circuit import Parameter, ParameterVector
from qiskit.providers.aer import AerSimulator
from qiskit.utils import QuantumInstance
from qiskit_algorithms import VQE

from qiskit.algorithm import Eigensolver
from qiskit_algorithms.optimizers import COBYLA

from qiskit import transpile
from qiskit_aer import AerSimulator
from qiskit.transpiler import PassManager

from qiskit_ibm_runtime.options import ResilienceOptions

# Define the XXZ Hamiltonian
Hamiltonian = [
    ["zz", 1], ["xx", 1], ["yy", 1], ["zz", Delta], ["zz", 1]]

# Define the observables

    SparsePauliOp(SparsePauliOp.from_list(["zz", "zz"]), insert_z2symmetries=True),
    SparsePauliOp(SparsePauliOp.from_list(["xx", "yy"]), insert_z2symmetries=True),
    SparsePauliOp(SparsePauliOp.from_list(["zz", "zz", "zz", "zz"]), insert_z2symmetries=True)
]

# Define the parameter sweep
delta_values = np.arange(-3.00, 3.05, 0.25)

qc = QuantumCircuit(10)

# Define the parameter vector
params = ParameterVector("theta", 10)

# Define the circuit parameters
for i in range(10):
    qc.rx(params[i], i)

observable_circuits = []
for observable in observables:

    observable_circuit.append(observable, range(10))

The error mitigation options are set to the maximum level, including TREX, ZNE, PEC, dynamical decoupling, and Pauli twirling. The noise-aware performance is estimated by repeating the calculations with shot noise and averaging the results.
